第893章 梦境的影响（第1页）
至于离开咖啡店后要去哪里，说实话她也不知道。
而且在梦里的时候，她自己是没有身体掌控权的，梦境让她做什么，带她去哪里，她就得跟着行动。
于是她只能眼睁睁看着自己起身，和那个男人一块走出了咖啡店门口。
没错，她的车，和她现实中的车一模一样的车。
汤元堂姐怎么都没想到，这个梦竟然能做到和现实这么贴近，就连她现实世界里的车都能在梦里看到。
不过在意识到她和那个男人上的是自己的车时，她心里其实还有点不舒服。
她自己的车和房子，其实都算是自己的私人空间。
如果不是关系非常好的朋友或者亲戚，她根本不会让他们去自己家里，或者坐在自己的车。
所以当看到梦里的“她”让那个男人上自己的车时，汤元堂姐一方面觉得不舒服，一方面又有些惊讶。
如果这个梦里的“她”是按照自己现实中的性格打造的话，那么“她”和这个男人的关系得是熟悉到什么程度，才会让“她”愿意让这个男人坐她的车呢。
前几个梦里的时候，她只觉得自己和这个男人之间有点暧昧，猜测的是，这个男人可能是其他人给自己介绍的相亲对象之类的。
如果是这样的话，那他们约在咖啡厅见面，然后还边聊边笑，其实都能说得通。
但如果单纯是相信对象，她相信，按照她的性格，是绝对不会让一个相亲对象坐自己的车的。
结果梦里的“她”不仅让男人坐上了她的车，还让他坐上了副驾驶！
汤元堂姐不知道别人对副驾驶的定义是什么，但在她看来，那绝对只有关系非常好的人才能坐。
其余人，就算是一般的亲戚，她也都会让他们坐后面。
结果梦里的“她”竟然让那个男人坐到了副驾驶，一个和她那么近的位置。

难道说，这个男人和“她”的关系，远比她想象的还要亲近？
到这里的时候，一切都已经很让汤元堂姐惊讶了。
但她万万没想到的是，更让她震惊的事情，还在后面。
车子启动之后，梦里的“她”和福副驾驶的男人依旧在闲聊，而且两人的脸上都能看出微笑的痕迹。
汤元堂姐对自己很了解，完全能够看得出来“她”脸上的笑容是真心实意的，没有半点敷衍之色。
至于那个男人的笑容是不是真诚的，她无法确定。
不过唯一可以肯定的是，他笑起来确实很帅，而且越看越帅。
最后梦里的两人一路说说笑笑，终于到达了目的地。
这座公园是他们这附近出了名的风景优美，适合散步的地方。
现实世界里，汤元堂姐也经常来这边散步，不过大多数时候都是下班之后自己一个人来。
对于她而言，来这边散步不仅是为了锻炼身体，同时还是为了减轻工作压力。
她有车有房工资高，这些可不是大风刮来的，而是自己实打实的干业绩挣来的。
工作压力太大，下班之后，公司里很多同事都会找各种发泄压力的事情做。
大部分人喜欢去运动，或者是去唱歌，喝酒，甚至买买买之类的。
她最喜欢的就是趁着公园人少的时候，来这里散步放空。
这个方式，她连堂弟他们都没有告诉过，算是自己的一个小秘密。
没想到梦里的“她”竟然会带着这个男人过来。
或许这个男人和“她”，关系真的不一般。
又或者说，“她”对这个男人很上心。
梦里，两人在散步的时候一直在聊天，聊的也都是一些很稀疏平常的话题，但是彼此间的氛围非常好。

就算没有影视剧的特效，也能让汤元堂姐感受到那种“粉色泡泡”。
原本她是想通过梦里来摸清楚她为什么会频繁梦到这个陌生男人的。
但是在看到梦里这些场景后，不自觉因为这些氛围和情节受到影响，对于这个男人的印象越来越深，越来越好了。

Chapter 893 The Influence of Dreams (Page 1)
As for where to go after leaving the coffee shop, to be honest, she didn't know.
And when she was in the dream, she had no control over her body. She had to follow whatever the dream asked her to do and where it took her.
So she could only watch as she stood up and walked out of the coffee shop with the man.
Yes, her car is exactly the same as her real car.
Cousin Tang Yuan never expected that this dream could be so close to reality. Even the car in her real world could be seen in her dream.
But when she realized that she and the man were getting into her car, she actually felt a little uncomfortable.
Her own car and house are actually her own private space.
If they are not very close friends or relatives, she will not let them go to her home or sit in her car.
So when she saw "her" in the dream letting the man get into her car, cousin Tang Yuan felt uncomfortable on the one hand, and a little surprised on the other.
If the "she" in this dream is based on her personality in reality, then how familiar the relationship between "she" and this man must be before "she" is willing to let this man sit in her car.
In the first few dreams, she only felt that there was a bit of ambiguity between herself and this man. Her guess was that this man might be a blind date introduced to her by others.
If this is the case, then it would actually make sense for them to meet at a coffee shop and chat and laugh.
But if she simply trusted the person, she believed that according to her personality, she would never let a blind date sit in her car.
As a result, "she" in the dream not only let the man sit in her car, but also let him sit in the passenger seat!
Cousin Tang Yuan didn’t know what other people’s definition of co-pilot was, but in her opinion, only people with very good relationships could sit there.
For the rest of the people, even ordinary relatives, she would let them sit in the back.
As a result, the "she" in the dream actually let the man sit in the passenger seat, a seat so close to her.
Could it be that the relationship between this man and "her" was far closer than she imagined?
When we got here, everything surprised Cousin Tang Yuan.
But what she never expected was that something even more shocking was yet to come.
After the car started, "she" in the dream and the man in Fu's passenger seat were still chatting, and traces of smiles could be seen on their faces.
Cousin Tang Yuan knew her very well and could tell that the smile on "her" face was sincere and not perfunctory at all.
As for whether the man's smile was sincere, she couldn't be sure.
But the only thing that is certain is that he does look handsome when he smiles, and the more he looks at him, the more handsome he becomes.
In the end, the two people in the dream were talking and laughing all the way, and finally reached their destination.
This park is a famously beautiful place for walking in their neighborhood.
In the real world, cousin Tang Yuan often comes here for walks, but most of the time she comes alone after get off work.
For her, walking here is not only to exercise, but also to relieve work stress.
She has a car, a house, and a high salary. These are not brought by strong winds, but earned by her own hard work.
The work pressure is too great. After get off work, many colleagues in the company will find various things to do to vent their stress.
Most people like to play sports, sing, drink, or even go shopping.
What she likes most is taking advantage ofWhen there are few people in the park, take a walk here to relax.
She didn't even tell her cousins ​​about this method, it was considered a little secret of hers.
Unexpectedly, the "she" in the dream would bring this man here.
Maybe the relationship between this man and "her" is really unusual.
In other words, "she" is very interested in this man.
In the dream, the two of them kept chatting while walking, and they talked about some very sparse and ordinary topics, but the atmosphere between them was very good.
Even without the special effects of film and television dramas, cousin Tang Yuan can still feel the "pink bubbles".
Originally, she wanted to find out through her dreams why she frequently dreamed of this strange man.
But after seeing these scenes in the dream, I was unconsciously affected by the atmosphere and plot, and my impression of this man became deeper and deeper.
